description: This file defines the `SimpleXStreamSerializer` class which implements the serialization and deserialization of objects using the XStream library within the OpenMRS framework. It manages whitelisting types, configuring security, and provides methods for serializing objects to XML and deserializing XML back into objects. It also handles setup of custom XStream configurations and proxies.
